description: Only for the Awning team. Queue of business applications with owner contacts and warnings. route tells how each is handled: review (new owner), known_owner (the owner already runs a live business, listed in owner_runs), auto_branch (a new location that went live without review; see status approved), rename (a live business asked for a new name: rename.from → rename.to; the warnings are about the new name).
